recentItems.title: Sitrep: Can the UK Strategic Reserve be reawakened?
recentItems.description:
In theory 95,000 veterans could be liable for recall if the UK was at war, or headed that way, but for decades it’s been little more than a notional force, lying dormant.
 
That is about to change though.  Thousands could soon get letters calling them up for an exercise next year, to help the MoD faces challenges as basic as locating people, let alone equipping and training them.
 
Sitrep explains why this is only a first step to generating a force which could be vital within a few years and what these reservists could be asked to do in a crisis, while veterans campaigner Jonny Ball tells us how it will go down with those asked to step up.
 
And as Russian bombardment of Ukraine reaches new record levels we get a first hand taste of the reality, when an airstrike interrupts our conversation with Colin Freeman.

Kate Gerbeau presents, with expert analysis from Professor Michael Clarke.

#podcast #military #explained #armedforces

recentItems.title: We go behind the wheel of Ineos’ Military Grenadier - British Army’s potential next 4x4
recentItems.description:
Could this be the British Army’s next 4x4? 🇬🇧🚙

We go inside the Ineos factory in Warwickshire for the official launch of Team Grenadier – a consortium bidding to replace the British military’s iconic Land Rover fleet.

With around 5,000 Land Rovers being retired, the Armed Forces are looking for a new light mobility vehicle by 2030. Ineos is going up against major contenders including GM Defense and Jaguar Land Rover.

We take a closer look at the military-spec Grenadier, including an armoured prototype designed to provide protection against high-velocity rounds and artillery shrapnel.

The contenders are due to deliver demonstration vehicles to the Ministry of Defence in October, with a decision on the replacement for the Land Rover expected next year.

Could the Grenadier be the Land Rover’s successor? Let us know what you think in the comments.

#BritishArmy #IneosGrenadier #LandRover #Military #ForcesNews
